t: The $(item)Module Expansion Card/$ is a pluggable circuit board which you can attach to $(l:tubes/tube_modules)Tube Modules/$ to enhance their functionality in various ways. $(thing)Right-click/$ the card on a Tube Module to apply it.$(p)See the pages for individual tube modules for more information on how the module is enhanced.
$(item)模块拓展卡/$是一种可插拔电路板，你可以将其安装到$(l:tubes/tube_modules)管道模块/$上，以通过多种方式增强其功能。$(thing)右击/$管道模块上的这张卡即可应用。$(p)有关模块如何得到增强的更多信息，请参阅各个管道模块对应的页面。
